mergedParams.userDescription: Quad-split screen zoom into one panel transition effects between videos

output.title: Quad Split to Single Panel Zoom Transitions

prompts.prompt: Create a quad-split screen transition where four video panels gradually zoom and converge into a single focused panel. The transition starts with a 2x2 grid layout showing four simultaneous videos. During the transition, three panels fade out with a subtle blur effect while the selected panel scales up smoothly to fill the entire screen. Use a 1.5-second overlap period where the non-selected panels gradually reduce opacity from 100% to 0% while applying an increasing blur filter (0px to 8px). The selected panel should scale from 50% to 100% size with an ease-in-out curve. Position all four initial panels using absolute positioning with 50% width and height, placed at the four corners. The transition should feel like diving into one of the quadrants, with a cinematic zoom effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' classes. Four VideoAtom components positioned absolutely: top-left (top-0 left-0), top-right (top-0 right-0), bottom-left (bottom-0 left-0), bottom-right (bottom-0 right-0), each with 'w-1/2 h-1/2'. During transition, apply generic effects in provider mode: non-selected panels get opacity animation [1 to 0] and filter blur [0px to 8px] over 1.5s. Selected panel gets transform scale animation [0.5 to 1] and position animation from corner to center (translate-x and translate-y from initial position to 0). BaseLayout duration = sum of all video durations with 1.5s overlap between quad view and single view. Use z-index-10 for selected panel during transition.

prompts.prompt: Design a dynamic quad-split collapse transition where four video panels slide and rotate into a central point before expanding into the next scene. Start with four equal-sized video panels arranged in a grid. As the transition begins, each panel rotates slightly (5-10 degrees) while sliding toward the center point with different timing offsets (0ms, 100ms, 200ms, 300ms stagger). Once collapsed at center, the new video expands outward with a spring-like bounce effect. Use a 2-second total transition with the collapse taking 1 second, a 200ms pause at center, and 800ms for the expansion. Add motion blur during the slide movements for a more dynamic feel.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden bg-black'. Four outgoing VideoAtoms with 'absolute w-1/2 h-1/2' positioned at corners. Apply staggered generic effects: transform animations combining translate (to center point), rotate (5-10deg), and scale (1 to 0.1) with cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) easing. Incoming VideoAtom starts at scale 0.1 at center, then scales to 1 with overshoot. Use filter effects for motion blur during movement (blur 0 to 3px to 0). Z-index layering: outgoing panels z-10 to z-40 (staggered), incoming video z-50. Calculate overlap as 2 seconds where outgoing videos end at their original duration and incoming starts 2s before outgoing ends.

prompts.prompt: Build a cinematic quad-split wipe transition where panels sequentially wipe away diagonally to reveal the focused video underneath. Begin with four video quadrants displaying different content. The transition uses a diagonal wipe pattern: top-left panel wipes to bottom-right, top-right to bottom-left, bottom-left to top-right, and bottom-right to top-left. Each wipe has a 300ms duration with 100ms delays between each panel start. The selected panel is already playing underneath at full size but masked by the quad layout. As panels wipe away, they reveal portions of the full video. Add a subtle glow edge effect along the wipe line for a sci-fi aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Selected VideoAtom positioned 'absolute inset-0 w-full h-full' with z-index-0, playing continuously. Four masking VideoAtoms as quadrants with 'absolute w-1/2 h-1/2' and higher z-index (10-40). Apply clip-path animations for diagonal wipes using polygon values transitioning from full visibility to zero. Example: top-left uses clip-path polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%, 0 0) to polygon(100% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 100% 100%). Add CSS filter drop-shadow for glow effect along wipe edge. Stagger start times: 0ms, 100ms, 200ms, 300ms. Total transition duration 600ms with no opacity changes, purely clip-path based.

prompts.prompt: Create an explosive quad-split shatter transition where the four panels break apart with a shake effect before reforming into the single focused video. Start with stable quad layout, then trigger a brief but intense shake (5 frames at 60fps) where each panel vibrates in place. Following the shake, panels scatter outward in different directions (top-left moves up-left, top-right moves up-right, etc.) while simultaneously rotating and scaling down. As they move off-screen, the selected video scales up from 50% to 100% from behind. Include particle-like shadow effects during the shatter for added drama. Total transition time of 1.8 seconds with shake at 0.5s mark.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-visible' to allow panels to move beyond bounds. Four VideoAtoms with initial 'absolute w-1/2 h-1/2' positioning. Shake effect: rapid transform translateX/Y animations alternating between -5px and 5px over 83ms (5 frames). Post-shake scatter: transform animations combining translate (200% distance in respective directions), rotate (random 15-45deg), scale (1 to 0), and opacity (1 to 0) over 1.3s with ease-in acceleration. Selected video starts at scale 0.5 with z-index-0, scales to 1 with ease-out. Add multiple box-shadow values during scatter for particle effect. Overlap period starts at shake moment (0.5s into first videos).

prompts.prompt: Design a smooth morph transition where four video panels fluidly merge and blend into a single cohesive video. Each quadrant gradually shifts position while their edges blur and blend together at the seams. The transition uses a combination of scale, position, and opacity effects where overlapping areas briefly show both videos with screen blend mode. Start with crisp quadrant boundaries, then apply increasing blur to panel edges (0 to 20px) while panels slide toward center and scale up to create overlap zones. The selected panel gradually dominates through opacity while others fade. Include a brief color flash at the moment of full convergence for impact.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden mix-blend-normal'. Four VideoAtoms initially 'absolute w-1/2 h-1/2' with sharp boundaries. Apply mask-image with linear-gradient for edge softening during transition. Generic effects: transform scale (1 to 1.1) and translate (toward center by 5%), filter blur on edges via CSS mask, opacity (non-selected: 1 to 0, selected: 0.7 to 1). Use mix-blend-mode: screen on overlapping panels during merge. Add a fifth ShapeAtom as white flash overlay: opacity 0 to 0.8 to 0 over 100ms at convergence point. Total transition 2s with gradual overlap increase from 0% to 20% panel overlap. Z-index: selected panel highest, others staggered below.

prompts.prompt: Build a spiral zoom transition where four video quadrants rotate around a central axis while the selected panel spirals forward to fill the screen. Each quadrant maintains its content but rotates as part of a larger spinning motion (full 360-degree rotation). During the spin, non-selected panels gradually shrink and fade while the selected panel grows and moves along a spiral path toward the viewer. Add motion trail effects by duplicating panels with reduced opacity and slight time offset. The spiral should feel like falling through a tunnel of videos, with the selected one catching you at the end.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden perspective-1000' for 3D depth. Container div with 'absolute inset-0 transform-style-preserve-3d' wrapping all VideoAtoms. Four videos positioned as quadrants, each with transform-origin set to center of screen. Apply combined transform animations: rotateZ (0 to 360deg) on container, individual panel transforms for spiral motion using translateZ (0 to -500px for non-selected, 0 to 200px for selected), scale adjustments based on Z position. Create motion trail with duplicate VideoAtoms at 0.3 opacity, 50ms behind main panels. Total duration 2.5s with ease-in-out. Selected panel ends at translateZ(0) scale(1) filling screen.

prompts.prompt: Create a liquid flow transition where the four video panels melt and flow together like liquid mercury before reforming as the single selected video. Each panel initially displays normally, then begins to distort with wave-like effects along the edges. The panels flow toward the center with undulating motion, briefly creating a swirling vortex effect before the selected video emerges from the center, expanding outward in a circular reveal. Include subtle color shifting during the liquid phase for an otherworldly effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Four VideoAtoms with SVG filter effects for liquid distortion: feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap animated via CSS. Initial panels 'absolute w-1/2 h-1/2'. Apply custom CSS animations: clip-path using complex path animations to create flowing edges, transform with sin/cos based translations for undulating motion. Use CSS filter: hue-rotate animation (0 to 30deg to 0) during flow phase. Selected video starts with clip-path: circle(0% at center) expanding to circle(100% at center). Overlay blend modes during merge phase. Total transition 3s with peak distortion at 1.5s. Z-index management: flowing panels at z-10-40, selected emerging video at z-50.

prompts.prompt: Design a glitch-style quad transition where panels randomly flicker, shift, and distort before one panel takes over the full screen. The four videos play normally, then experience synchronized glitch effects: horizontal displacement, RGB channel splitting, digital noise, and frame drops. Each panel glitches with different intensities and patterns. The selected panel experiences the heaviest glitch before suddenly snapping into perfect full-screen clarity, while others corrupt and disappear. Include data moshing effects between frames for authenticity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden bg-black'. Four VideoAtoms 'absolute w-1/2 h-1/2' with initial clean display. Apply rapid, randomized transform translateX animations (-10px to 10px) at 40ms intervals for glitch displacement. CSS filters: contrast(2) saturate(2) for intensity, custom RGB split using multiple shadows (text-shadow equivalent for divs). Implement flicker via opacity: rapid 1-0-1 transitions at 20-40ms intervals. Selected panel: intense glitch for 500ms then instant clean transform scale(1) with inset-0. Non-selected: increasing corruption via combination of opacity strobing and transform skew before opacity 0. Total transition 1.5s with peak glitch at 0.7-1.2s range.

prompts.prompt: Build a prismatic refraction transition where the quad-split appears to pass through a prism, separating into rainbow spectrums before recombining into the focused video. Each panel shifts into different color channels (red, green, blue, and luminance) while moving in calculated trajectories that simulate light refraction. The panels stretch and skew as if bending through glass, with chromatic aberration effects at the edges. They converge at a focal point where color channels recombine to form the complete selected video. Add lens flare effects at the convergence point.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden bg-gray-900'. Four VideoAtoms with initial quad positioning, each with different CSS filter combinations: panel1 filter: sepia(1) hue-rotate(0deg), panel2: sepia(1) hue-rotate(120deg), panel3: sepia(1) hue-rotate(240deg), panel4: grayscale(1). Apply transform animations: skewX/skewY for refraction effect (0 to 15deg to 0), translateX/Y following bezier curves for prismatic paths, scale for perspective changes. Mix-blend-mode: screen during convergence. Add lens flare using radial-gradient ShapeAtom: opacity 0 to 1 to 0 at focal point. Chromatic aberration via box-shadow with red/blue offsets. Total transition 2.2s with convergence at 1.5s mark.

prompts.prompt: Create a dimensional fold transition where the four video panels appear to fold into each other like origami, revealing the selected video on the reverse side. Each quadrant rotates along its connecting edge with the appearance of paper folding in 3D space. The top panels fold downward, bottom panels fold upward, creating a closing book effect. As panels fold, they reveal the selected video playing on their 'reverse' side. Include realistic shadow effects during the fold and a subtle page-turn sound visualization through shadow patterns. The final moment shows all panels completing their fold to display the full selected video.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden perspective-2000px'. Four VideoAtoms positioned as quadrants with transform-origin set to their connecting edges (top panels: bottom edge, bottom panels: top edge, etc.). Apply 3D rotation animations: rotateX for horizontal folds (-180deg for top, 180deg for bottom panels) with preserve-3d. Selected video placed behind at z-index-0, revealed as panels fold away. Add shadow overlays using linear-gradient divs that animate opacity and position to simulate fold shadows. Backface-visibility: hidden on folding panels. Use ease-in-out timing for realistic paper physics. Total transition 2s with staggered fold starts (0ms, 200ms delays). Include brief scale bounce on selected video at completion (scale 1 to 1.02 to 1 over 200ms).
